summary: Silgan Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a November 6, 2026 Consent to Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo as Administrative Agent, tied to the previously announced October 17, 2026 Transaction Agreement with A-VL Holdco, LP. Silgan will contribute its metal food/general line containers, metal and plastic vacuum closures, non-dispensing plastic dairy and aluminum roll-on closures businesses to newly formed Silgan Metal Packaging LLC. Lenders consented to MetalCo's Unrestricted Subsidiary designation, guarantor and equity-pledge releases, and limited-condition-acquisition covenant testing. Watch closing conditions and proceeds use for debt redemption.
